conceptCards.title: Record, Exclude, Extract, and NonNullable

conceptCards.title: Parameters, ReturnType, ConstructorParameters
conceptCards.summary: Parameters, ReturnType, ConstructorParameters is where JavaScript dynamic typing surprises C# developers — implicit ToNumber, ToString, and truthiness rules that === and Object....

conceptCards.title: Composing utility types for DTOs and API layers
conceptCards.summary: Composing utility types for DTOs and API layers is compile-time type manipulation — erased at run time but essential for safe APIs.
conceptCards.example: type Unwrap<T> = T extends Promise<infer U> ? U : T;
